chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Musa, from Ghiyas, from Is-haq ibn 'Ammar, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Allah disliked for me six characteristics, then I disliked them for the successors from my offspring and their followers after me: obscenity during fasting.'
ai.seo_question: What are the six characteristics disliked by Allah for the Prophet and his successors, particularly regarding fasting?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the spiritual continuity between the Prophet and the Imams by extending divine aversion to 'rafath' (obscenity or vocalizing sexual matters) to the Ahl al-Bayt and their followers. It underscores that the etiquette of fasting transcends mere physical abstinence from food, requiring purity of speech and mind, a principle deeply rooted in Shia jurisprudence regarding the sanctity of the fast.
